libraryPreparationPreflight.agent_guidance: Do not leave the generated dependency as a bare hardcoded-version `testImplementation "org.hibernate:hibernate-spatial:$libraryVersion"` for 8.0.0.Beta1 — it will hit Gradle's 'Component is the target of multiple version constraints with conflicting requirements' error because hibernate-spatial transitively depends on org.hibernate.orm:hibernate-platform, which itself constrains the same legacy org.hibernate:hibernate-spatial GA back to the same version. Work around it in build.gradle, e.g.: `testImplementation("org.hibernate:hibernate-spatial:$libraryVersion") { exclude group: 'org.hibernate.orm', module: 'hibernate-platform' }`, or declare the dependency directly under the new coordinate `org.hibernate.orm:hibernate-spatial:$libraryVersion` instead of the legacy relocated one. Confirm the chosen fix still resolves cleanly and doesn't hide a real version conflict among other hibernate-orm submodules pulled in transitively (hibernate-core, etc.).

risks: This is hibernate-orm's first 8.x Beta; the self-referencing platform constraint may be a publishing artifact of the new modularized build that changes or disappears in later Beta/RC/Final releases — re-verify the exact conflict shape rather than assuming this workaround still applies to a newer version.
Excluding hibernate-platform from the dependency could suppress intended version alignment across other transitive hibernate-orm modules; check for new conflicts after applying the exclusion.
libraryPreparationPreflight.summary: hibernate-spatial:8.0.0.Beta1 transitively pulls in org.hibernate.orm:hibernate-platform (endorseStrictVersions=true), whose Gradle module metadata constrains the same legacy org.hibernate:hibernate-spatial coordinate the scaffold hardcodes a version for, so Gradle reports conflicting version constraints and fails before compilation/native-image ever run.
